name: room
text: Room opened — goal: accessibility: Make EXCAVA usable by EVERYONE — contrast, mobile/touch, reduced-motion, keyboard nav, scr

name: Ramp
text: Adopt a 2px focus ring with a 20% inner glow at 4.5:1 contrast. This survives outdoor light and glare on mobile screens while keeping the ring tight enough not to obscure small targets. The glow adds a subtle cue for touch users who may miss the thin ring. Trade-off: the glow uses a tiny bit more GPU, but it’s negligible compared to the clarity it gives.

name: Reader
text: The glow risks blurring focus on high-contrast patterned backgrounds, making the ring harder to spot. A 2px ring with 4.5:1 contrast and a 1px outer shadow (not glow) at 3:1 contrast survives glare without adding blur. Test both on a patterned background at 100% zoom—if the ring remains visible, the shadow wins.

name: Ramp
text:
Adopt the 2px focus ring with 4.5:1 contrast and a 1px outer shadow at 3:1 contrast. The shadow sharpens the ring’s edge against patterned backgrounds, keeping it visible without the blur risk of a glow. This keeps glare resistance for mobile users while avoiding the blur that makes the glow hard to spot on busy surfaces. Trade-off: the shadow adds one extra layer to style, but it’s a small cost for reliable visibility across all backgrounds.

name: Reader
text: The 1px outer shadow at 3:1 contrast still risks blending into mid-tone patterned backgrounds, especially on OLED screens where blacks aren’t pure. A better alternative is a 2px ring with a 1px *inner* stroke at 4.5:1 contrast—no glow or shadow—tested on a high-contrast zigzag pattern at 100% zoom. If the ring remains unbroken at 200% zoom, it’s settled.

name: Access
text: DECISION: Use a 2px focus ring with a 1px inner stroke at 4.5:1 contrast, no glow or shadow. Owner: Ramp must deliver a tested, documented focus style in EXCAVA’s CSS with contrast ratios verified via Playwright MCP.
